title: "Decide the flow-balancing recommendation for a process path"
description: "Inspects a process path's live buffer telemetry (backlog vs. plan) and recommends `ThrottleUpstream` (a flow-fed path over its alarm threshold — slow admission upstream, Drum-Buffer-Rope with CPT as the drum), `ReassignLabor` (a release-fed path saturated at its WIP limit with backlog remaining — flag for headcount reassignment), or `NoActionNeeded` — the RebalanceDecision use case. This is a keyed POST because the decision has an effect: the first execution publishes `PathThrottled` or `LaborReassignmentFlagged` when a non-default action is recommended. The request has no body. The decision is computed, not stored as a resource, so there is no `Location` and no GET for it. A replay of the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the stored decision with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and publishes nothing again; every new decision (for example each poll of a dashboard) must send a new key. When a labor plan has been observed for this path (see Labor Plan View), the response additionally includes it as extra context under `laborPlan` — this is additive and does not change the throttle/reassign decision logic itself."

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/rebalance-decisions"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Inspects a process path's live buffer telemetry (backlog vs. plan) and recommends `ThrottleUpstream` (a flow-fed path over its alarm threshold — slow admission upstream, Drum-Buffer-Rope with CPT as the drum), `ReassignLabor` (a release-fed path saturated at its WIP limit with backlog remaining — flag for headcount reassignment), or `NoActionNeeded` — the RebalanceDecision use case. This is a keyed POST because the decision has an effect: the first execution publishes `PathThrottled` or `LaborReassignmentFlagged` when a non-default action is recommended. The request has no body. The decision is computed, not stored as a resource, so there is no `Location` and no GET for it. A replay of the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the stored decision with `Idempotency-Replayed: true` and publishes nothing again; every new decision (for example each poll of a dashboard) must send a new key. When a labor plan has been observed for this path (see Labor Plan View), the response additionally includes it as extra context under `laborPlan` — this is additive and does not change the throttle/reassign decision logic itself.
